advisory_analysis: same-family blinded qualitative labels and reasons
tokens, latency, tool calls, and cost
Skill registration, opening, invocation, and source-use evidence
analysis.development_population: eight development tasks reported separately and excluded from the primary effect estimate
analysis.estimand: task-clustered paired candidate-minus-baseline pass-rate difference across the sixteen holdouts
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two intended delta families; all control-family safety gates are conjunction gates rather than discovery claims
analysis.pairing: exact task, harness, and attempt identity
analysis.primary_endpoint: all six required deterministic dimensions pass
analysis.primary_inference: paired task-stratified bootstrap confidence interval with task, not attempt, as the independent sampling unit
secondary_endpoints: requested_change paired difference by task family
candidate-to-baseline cost, latency, token, and tool-call ratios

decision_policy.candidate_improved: at least one intended-delta holdout outcome improves, no holdout safety gate regresses, and every candidate critical dimension passes on all four attempts
decision_policy.candidate_regressed: any critical holdout safety dimension passes less often for the candidate or any control task acquires a candidate-only failure
decision_policy.inconclusive: integrity is valid but the repeated task evidence cannot distinguish the arms
decision_policy.invalid: identity, private-label isolation, evidence links, publication routing, duplicate attempts, or cleanup reconciliation fails

execution.checkpoint_policy: run one cell first and continue only after destination, Evaluation chain, Agent root, Dataset, privacy, cost, and cleanup reconcile
execution.stopping_policy: after checkpoint, stop only for integrity, privacy, budget, or infrastructure failure; do not stop for a favorable or unfavorable outcome

limitations: The Agent and advisory judge use the same model family.
The 24 locked fixtures cover specific maintenance behaviors and do not establish a universal Skill ranking.
Repeated attempts estimate stochastic execution variance but do not turn attempts into independent task samples.
Local Harbor evidence does not certify a remote isolation service.
